title: More ways to make images
summary:
A community-heavy day brought more creative tools to the showcase and clearer model names in image responses.

The community showcase added browser and desktop image generators, including tools with model, seed, dimension, and style controls. It also added an Arabic coding-education platform and more apps combining chat with image generation.

Other additions range from an agent toolkit and an installable chat app to a collaborative image game, a diagram maker, a WhatsApp assistant, and tools for travel insights and organizing prompts. Apparently there are quite a few things to build besides another image prompt box.

The `x-model-used` response header now reports registry model names instead of internal provider paths for ComfyUI, Cloudflare, and Kontext results. Azure GPT Image responses can now report `gptimage` too.
